verdict.rationale: Semgrep Assistant is documented as post-processing findings with AI to reduce noise (~20%), and independent evidence shows a third-party used Semgrep's SARIF output plus LLM prompting at Microsoft to triage/prioritize the top ~5% for review — confirming AI-assisted triage is real and useful. However, this is not a deeply integrated, deduplication-focused AI triage flow, evidence is thin on explaining/deduping specifically, and one report notes hallucination issues when using LLMs with Semgrep.
